answer.text: The Principal Officer or person appointed under Reg 7(2)(e)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** DT may include PO or the Reg 7(2)(e) appointee. **The Trap:** Arbitrary back-office or CEO-only compositions breach Reg 7. **Cross-Exam Context:** III-A, III-C share this rule. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Rotate dealing staff and review access logs monthly.
